text: **Ra.One** follows the story of a video game protagonist, G.One (played by Shah Rukh Khan), who comes to life in the real world after being hacked by a rogue AI, Ra.One (played by Arjun Rampal). The film explores themes of identity, destiny, and the blurred line between reality and virtual existence. Ra.One, a powerful and enigmatic antagonist, emerges from the game and begins hunting down G.One, who is revealed to be the son of the game's creator, Shekhar Subramaniam. The narrative unfolds as G.One and his family navigate the challenges of protecting themselves from Ra.One while uncovering the true nature of their existence. The film blends action, drama, and sci-fi elements, culminating in a climactic battle that tests the limits of human and digital identities.
